Predicates:
Aurochs(x) ::: x is an aurochs.
Extinct(x) ::: x is extinct.
Resemble(x, y) ::: x resembles y.
Animals(x) ::: x is an animal.
BreedingBack(x) ::: x is a form of artificial selection by breeding back.
HeckCattle(x) ::: x is heck cattle.

Premises:
HeckCattle(x) ∧ BreedingBack(x) ::: Heck cattle were bred-back in the 1920s.
Aurochs(x) ∧ Animals(x) ::: Aurochs are animals.
Resemble(x, y) ::: Some animals to be bred-back resemble animals that are extinct.

Conclusion:
Extinct(Aurochs) ::: Aurochs are extinct.
